entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: a mixed float/histogram 'or' operand paired with a %s-shaped operand is not supported
entries.rationale: both callers (vectorPlainArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's own recognizer, via lowerVectorPlainArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, and comparisonVectorPlainOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's, via lowerComparisonVectorPlainOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp) reach this default switch arm only when RowShapeOf(plainNode) is neither SampleRowShape, GridWindowRowShape, nor ReducedWindowRowShape, i.e. HistogramRowShape or MixedRowShape — believed unreachable through any parseable query today, the same way lowerMixedExpHistogramOperands's own identical fallback (histogram_native_mixed_or.go) already is: both recognizers exclude the plain operand via isExpHistogramValuedShape (rejecting a genuinely histogram-valued plain side, out of this piece's scope) and via mixedExpHistogramSetOp (rejecting a plain side that is itself another mixed `or`, vectorVectorArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's own shape) BEFORE ever calling lower() on it here, so no shape lower() could resolve to Histogram/MixedRowShape survives to reach this switch. A defensive guard against a future histogram-aware lowering silently mis-projecting through this path, not a live divergence.

guard: default of switch shape over [case chplan.SampleRowShape, chplan.GridWindowRowShape, chplan.ReducedWindowRowShape; default]
